title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Job Description – Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Reporting To:** AGM – HR  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years

Role Purpose

To drive talent acquisition activities and support HR operations across the organization. The role will focus on workforce planning, talent sourcing and pipeline development, while also managing key HR operational activities to ensure smooth employee lifecycle management and consistent implementation of HR processes.

Key ResponsibilitiesA. Talent Acquisition – 60%

* **Talent Acquisition Planning:** Coordinate with department heads and project teams to understand current and future manpower requirements, prioritize vacancies and develop recruitment plans aligned with business needs.
* **Talent Mapping & Pipeline Development:** Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical positions through LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, networking and other sourcing channels.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Work closely with hiring managers to understand job requirements, finalize candidate profiles, coordinate interviews and obtain timely selection decisions.
* **End-to-End Recruitment:** Manage the recruitment cycle, including resume screening, initial candidate discussions, interview coordination, salary negotiations, offer release and joining follow-up.
* **Recruitment MIS & Analytics:** Maintain recruitment trackers and monitor vacancies, sourcing effectiveness, time-to-fill, offer acceptance and joining ratios. Share regular recruitment updates with HR management.

B. HR Operations – 40%

* **Employee Lifecycle Management:** Coordinate onboarding, joining formalities, employee documentation, induction and exit formalities to ensure a smooth employee experience.
* **Attendance, Leave & HRIS Management:** Monitor attendance and leave records, support the implementation of HR policies and ensure proper use of the FactoHR application and other HR systems.
* **HR Reporting & Employee Support:** Maintain employee records, prepare HR reports, support HR policy implementation and assist employees and managers with routine HR queries and operational requirements.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* **Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources will be an advantage.
* **Experience:** 4–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition and HR Operations, preferably in construction, infrastructure, engineering or project-based organizations.
* **Talent Acquisition Expertise:** Experience in manpower planning, talent mapping, sourcing strategies, stakeholder coordination and end-to-end recruitment.
* **HR Operations Knowledge:** Practical experience in onboarding, employee documentation, attendance and leave management, HRIS and employee lifecycle processes.
* **Communication & Coordination:** Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with hiring managers, employees, candidates and recruitment consultants.
* **Planning & Results Orientation:** Strong organizational, analytical and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple recruitment requirements while ensuring accuracy and timely completion of HR operational activities.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹650,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

description:
**Senior QA Engineer Specialist**

**Esko | Veralto Corporation**

**Location:** Bangalore, India | On-site

**Reports To:** Senior Team Leader

**About the Role**

**The Opportunity**

We’re seeking a self-driven Senior QA Specialist to strengthen quality engineering for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. In this hands-on role, you’ll independently own quality for assigned features and product areas, combining thoughtful manual testing with the creation and maintenance of reliable automated test scripts. You’ll work with the current SAHI-based automation suite and help evolve the framework, including evaluating Playwright or Selenium where appropriate.

You’ll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and the Senior Team Leader to translate product and technical risks into an effective test approach. You’ll execute tests, interpret results, distinguish product defects from automation or environment failures, and communicate evidence-based quality risks. Success means meaningful automation coverage, effective exploratory testing, earlier defect detection, and dependable test results for WebCenter Enterprise.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will:

* Independently own the test approach for assigned features and product areas: assess customer and technical risk, clarify acceptance criteria, estimate effort, prioritize coverage, and raise dependencies or quality concerns early.
* Design and execute a balanced set of manual and automated tests, including exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing; select the test layer and technique that best addresses the risk.
* Create, maintain, and improve reliable SAHI-based automated test scripts using established design patterns and reusable code; contribute to framework design and evaluate Playwright or Selenium where appropriate.
* Interpret test and CI/CD results, investigate failures systematically, and distinguish product defects from automation, test-data, or environment issues using logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence.
* Reduce flaky tests through root-cause analysis; maintain representative test data, repeatable setup and cleanup, dependable environments, and clear, actionable failure reporting.
* Collaborate with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to improve testability, find defects earlier, and align testing with delivery timelines and product quality goals.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve QA processes, tooling, and feedback loops while protecting the stability of existing coverage.
* Produce concise, accurate test cases, automation code, defect reports, traceability, and quality summaries; communicate coverage, evidence, blockers, and release risks clearly to stakeholders.
* Share domain knowledge and practical QA and automation techniques with colleagues, and use approved AI tools responsibly where useful while independently validating outputs and protecting proprietary and customer data.

**What We're Looking For**

**Minimum Qualifications**

*These are the must-have requirements for the role:*

* 8+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test automation, software development, or a combination thereof, including ownership of quality for complex web-product features.
* Strong hands-on ability in automated and manual testing, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining reusable automation code with established design patterns; practical programming or scripting skills in JavaScript, Java, or a comparable language; proficiency with Git, code review, and maintainable coding practices; and sound judgment in applying exploratory, functional, regression, and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation with SAHI, Selenium, Playwright, or a comparable framework, together with the ability to become productive in SAHI. SAHI is the current automation tool; prior expertise in SAHI is not required.
* Hands-on experience designing, organizing, and implementing automated unit, integration, and API tests with Java frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent solutions, including parameterized or data-driven testing; API coverage should include HTTP/REST, authentication, response and schema validation, and negative scenarios using RestAssured or comparable code-based tools, with Postman or similar tools for exploratory testing.
* Experience integrating, maintaining, and diagnosing automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, including analysis of failures and reliable reporting of results.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including interpreting test results and investigating failures with logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence.
* Experience testing web and client/server products, preferably Java/J2EE enterprise applications, with a good understanding of browser behavior, sessions, authentication, authorization, and integrations.
* Strong risk-based test-design skills, including equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, and state-transition testing.
* Ability to design representative test data, maintain repeatable setup and cleanup, and validate results and data integrity, including practical use of basic SQL queries where appropriate.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and contributing quality engineering and automation activities throughout iterative, sprint-based delivery.
* Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style, with the ability to explain quality risks, ask relevant questions, build consensus, and support less-experienced colleagues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

*The following qualifications will help distinguish stronger candidates; relevant experience in one or more of these areas is valued:*

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* Relevant professional testing certification, such as ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL); advanced or specialist credentials—particularly ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE), Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA), Quality in DevOps (CT-QDO), or an equivalent recognized certification are a differentiator for this senior automation-focused role.
* Practical experience using approved AI tools to accelerate test design, automation-code development, test-data generation, or failure analysis, with independent review and validation of outputs and appropriate protection of proprietary and customer data.
* Direct experience maintaining or evolving SAHI-based automation suites.
* Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices and experience using Cucumber to translate expected user behaviors and acceptance criteria into clear, executable test scenarios and maintainable automated test scripts.
* Experience with performance testing and tools such as JMeter.
* Experience testing AI-assisted features with non-deterministic outputs, including correctness, consistency, reliability, and safe fallback behavior.
* Working knowledge of Jira and Atlassian Wiki, or comparable platforms, for defect management, test documentation, and collaboration.
* Background in packaging, printing, or enterprise software product environments.

**About Esko**

It's all possible with a role at Esko. Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We are modernizing and simplifying our legacy landscape of over 110 SAP instances, shifting to a standardized, Clean Core S/4HANA Cloud platform.

  

Our ambition is to turn our ERP into a high-velocity engine powered by embedded AI, advanced analytics, and real-time data continuity.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to harmonize end-to-end business processes, deploy reusable assets, and drive structured governance across a global portfolio of execution projects.

**Come sharpen your craft, unleash your potential, and build the future with us!**

**About the Role**

Responsible for eliminating ambiguity and establishing end-to-end operational transparency, this role drives global performance tracking and accelerates business transformation through scalable, standardized Project Management (PM) solutions.

* Structuring Governance & Performance Tracking:
  + Define, establish, and maintain a standardized global performance tracking framework to drive transparency and remove operational ambiguities across ERP Accelerator Operations.

* Hybrid Methodology Enforcer & Standardizer (Waterfall/LBiP & Agile/SAFe):
  + Architect, deploy, and enforce standardized PM standards and lifecycle controls bridging Waterfall / LBIP (Launch-Base Implementation Process) governance with Agile / SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) execution.
  + Define clear interaction models between traditional milestone gates (LBIP) and SAFe Program Increments (PI Planning), System Demos, and Value Stream alignments.
  + Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on PM standards, providing coaching and guidelines to Release Train Engineers (RTEs), Product Managers, PMBPs, and Work Package Leaders.
* Operational Acceleration & Scalable PM Solutions:
  + Design and roll out scalable, reusable PM toolkits, templates, and automated workflows that streamline project administration and shorten cycle times.
  + Identify operational bottlenecks, continuous improvement opportunities, and process gaps across ERP Accelerator workstreams to accelerate transformation delivery.
  + Facilitate change management initiatives to secure high adoption of standardized PM practices across global delivery centers.
* Digital Tooling and Data Integrity:
  + Secure single-source-of-truth data integrity across the PM digital ecosystem, establishing automated data validation rules between Agile tracking tools and enterprise portfolio systems.
  + Champion "PM Governance" by integrating predictive analytics to identify performance drift, schedule variance, and delivery risks before they impact target milestones.
  Propose automation of repetitive status reporting, data aggregation, and compliance auditing using advanced analytics and AI capabilities.

  

**Dimensions**

* Scope of Impact: Global governance footprint across ERP Accelerator Operations and BCX PM Office initiatives (Europe, India, and global deployment sites).
* Stakeholder Network: Direct interface with ERP Operations Executives, Value Stream Owners, Release Train Engineers, PM Office Leaders, and Transnational PMBPs.
Methodology Scope: Oversight of hybrid delivery models managing multi-million-euro digital enterprise transformations.  

  

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* Experience: 7–10+ years of proven experience in Project Management Governance, Methods & Processes, and Performance Management within complex, transnational IT/ERP or aerospace engineering environments.
* SAP Activate & Hybrid Framework Mastery: Require demonstrated experience in defining or enforcing hybrid PM methodologies combining SAP Activate (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run) with enterprise Agile/SAFe or Waterfall/LBIP frameworks.
* SAP configuration or Technical Expertise is not required but instead PM process governance for large-scale enterprise ERP/SAP transformations is.
* Process Harmonization & Quality Gate Knowledge:
Excellent stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills with fluent English language Proficiency.  

  

**Certifications** :

Lean Six Sigma is a plus.  

  

**Competencies** :

* PM Operations & Performance (Advanced)

* Project Portfolio Management & Governance (Advanced)
* Risk & Opportunity Management Execution (Autonomous)
Stakeholder Management & Executive Alignment (Advanced)

**Technical Stack & Tooling**

title: Senior Manager, People Technology & Analytics
description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will...

* **Grow with an Ownership Mindset**: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place.
* **Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike:** At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.
* **Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose:** We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

**Location:** Remote in India

**Role Description:**

ShipBob is building a People Technology & Analytics function from the ground up, and this is the role that leads it.

Right now, our HR technology and people analytics capabilities exist, but they are distributed and not yet operating with a single coherent strategy. Core HCM lives in one place, Talent in another, Performance and OD systems in another, and a variety of other point system solutions throughout the People function. The data those systems generate is underutilized, integrations between them are inconsistent, and the opportunity to apply AI and automation thoughtfully across this landscape is full of opportunity. The goal for this role is to lead the efforts to close these gaps.

This is not an HRIS administration role nor a pure analytics function. You will lead building the operating model and function that ShipBob needs while doing meaningful technical work yourself along the way. If you are a player-coach who is energized by building something, who thinks in systems and roadmaps rather than tickets and configurations, and who has a genuine point of view on where AI creates real leverage in HR operations, this role was designed for you. This role reports to the Sr. Director, Total Rewards & HR Tech.

**What you'll do:**

* **People systems strategy and roadmap:** You are the strategic owner of how ShipBob thinks about its HR technology stack. That means making the build vs. buy calls, sequencing the investments, rationalizing what we have, and developing a point of view on what we need grounded in what the business requires. You will develop and maintain a People Technology & Analytics roadmap that reflects both near-term operational priorities and longer-term capability goals.
* **HR technology administration and architecture:** ShipBob's current stack includes ADP Workforce Now as core HCM, Greenhouse for recruiting, Lattice for performance and goal management, and a range of point solutions across the HR function. You will be responsible for the configuration strategy, integration architecture, and overseeing the ongoing administration of the full stack. You will also oversee and contribute toward building internal tooling and AI-powered workflows that close gaps.
* **People analytics program:** ShipBob does not yet have a structured people analytics capability. You will oversee development of data management, metric architecture, standard reporting cadences, and a roadmap of deeper workforce studies.
* **AI and automation strategy:** ShipBob is actively deploying AI agent tooling through our HR service center and enabling employees across the People team with access to AI-enabled tooling to build self-service solutions for process improvements and automations. You will partner with IT and People Leadership to develop a point of view on to drive long-term value in this space while avoiding redundancy and overspend.
* **Organizational design and team building:** You will assess the current state of People Technology & Analytics capability across ShipBob and develop a recommendation for what the right team structure looks like over the next 12 to 18 months. You will build the internal case for that structure and navigate the organizational dynamics required to bring it to life.
* **People Service Center partnership model:** ShipBob's People Service Center (PSC) is responsible for Tier 1 HR ticket resolution, data entry, and knowledge base management and operates adjacent to this function. This work is deeply intertwined with the systems and data this team owns. You will be accountable for defining a clear operating model for how PT&A and PSC work together: what each team owns, how they hand off, and how they complement each other.
* **Team leadership:** You will carry direct management responsibility for HRIS and analytics talent within this function and are expected to be an active, invested leader in developing the people on your team. As the function grows, so will your team. Building a culture of technical rigor, continuous learning, and high performance within People Technology & Analytics is part of the mandate.
* Other duties/responsibilities as necessary.

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* 8+ years in HR technology, HRIS, and people analytics, with at least 3 years in a formal leadership or team management role
* Direct experience with multiple HCM platforms across your career, not just deep expertise in one. You should be able to speak fluently about at least two to three different platforms and articulate how you evaluate which system is right for a given context.
* A demonstrated track record of operating as a player-coach: managing a team while personally owning meaningful technical deliverables.
* Experience developing and owning an HR technology roadmap, including build vs. buy decisions, vendor selection, and sequencing logic.
* Experience navigating organizational influence, driving technology change or consolidation with stakeholders who did not report to you and had their own stake in the current state.
* Independent people analytics capability: you can build a metrics framework, design a workforce study, or interpret a complex dataset without a dedicated analyst doing the work for you.
* Genuine curiosity and a specific point of view on how AI and automation apply to HR systems and operations.

**Strongly preferred**

* ADP Workforce Now, Greenhouse, and Lattice experience at an implementation or deep administration level

**Preferred**

* Experience at a multi-site, operationally complex company with both corporate and hourly/warehouse employee populations — logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or similar
* Exposure to agentic AI platforms, workflow automation tooling, or no-code/low-code build environments applied to HR workflows
* Experience building an org design case and presenting headcount recommendations to senior leadership
* This role requires a work schedule that covers at minimum 10am–2pm US Eastern time daily

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Medical, Term & Accidental Insurance
* All Purpose Leave (casual & sick time): 12 days
* Earned Leave: 15 days
* Public Holiday: 12 days
* Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave
* Quarterly Wellness Day
* Work From Home Allowance
* See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob)

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

**About You:**

Building the world's leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob's environment isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

Learn more about our core values and how we perform at a high level in our day-to-day work on our Culture page (https://www.shipbob.com/careers/culture/).

**About Us:**

  

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob's proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob's dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. ShipBob is backed by leading investors like Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and is one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in Chicago.

  

At ShipBob, every full-time employee gets access to our best-in-class AI and productivity tools from Day 1 at no cost. This isn't a pilot or a perk for select teams. It's standard for everyone. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. Whether you're in Talent, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or Customer Success, we expect you to ask: *how can this be done better, faster, or smarter?* These tools are our investment in your ability to find those answers.

**Use of AI-Assisted Tools During Recruitment**

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to support administrative functions such as transcribing interviews, generating summaries or notes, organizing interview feedback, facilitating candidate communications, and helping recruiters identify candidates whose qualifications may align with job requirements. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and are not used to make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by trained human reviewers who consider the candidate's application, interview performance, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. AI-assisted tools do not independently determine whether a candidate advances in the hiring process or receives an offer of employment. Where required by applicable law, candidates will be provided with notice regarding our use of AI-assisted technologies and, where available, information about any applicable rights relating to such processing, including the ability to request additional information or opt out of certain AI-assisted processing activities. Candidates who exercise available opt-out rights may be reviewed through alternative processes consistent with applicable law.

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence,* *c**ompensation**and training.*

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What will you do**
--------------------

Responsible for supply and demand balances for specified solids products, plus back-up for specified others

  

**Conduct Supply-Demand balancing process:**

  

* Coordinate cross functional team in maintaining the global supply/demand balance on Asset Production Lines, grade/packaging combinations, and numerous supply points
* Perform Supply/Demand balancing tasks (APO SNP module)
  + Collaborate with the Sales Demand Analyst/Planner and field Sales personnel to develop accurate demand forecasts
  + Work with Product Management and Sales to analyze and evaluate requests for additional demand and changes on production assets
  + Review feed and supply resource capacity
  + Balance supply and demand plan capabilities
  + Release balanced sales plan
* Agree and publish final sales plan to all regional stakeholders
  + Maintain Supply/Demand balances
  + Conduct monthly Supply/Demand S&OP review meeting (Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, Manufacturing)
  + Resolve supply issues including allocation product to markets served
* Lead Quick Response Teams (QRT) to assist in the proactive management supply, quality and logistical issues and to mitigate customer impacts
* Develop and facilitate the annual Corporate Plan for inventory targets, discretionary builds and supply/demand balances
* Ensure master data accuracy and maintenance
* Work with Manufacturing facilities to optimize production schedule
  + Set priorities for production schedule development and changes
  + Faciliate monthly Run Plan process: conduct analysis and prepare/present detailed communication package to align the cross functional organization on the S/D balance, commercial signals, and outlooks for production, forecast, sales and inventory
  + Align manufacturing capability with sales demand while working to optimize inventory levels
  + Assist prioritization of production in case of feed supply issues
  + Participates to structural improve initiatives (cycle optimization, production wheel optimization, inventory target optimization etc)
  + Set up production year plan for each production line on product family-level in agreement with Site SC and Manufacturing

**Support Demand Management Process**
-------------------------------------

* Point of contact for volume management specialists, replenisher team, and sales on availability issues
  + Set supply indicators to support order inflow management by sales
* Approve over and non-forecasted orders
  + Define APO allocation strategy and agree allocation levels on a monthly basis
  + Monitor order inflow versus forecast; review anomalies with sales
* Define APO allocation strategy
* Ensure proactive communication with Business stakeholders in case of Supply Issues
* Coordinate with Logistics teams in case of impactful changes in Supply network
  

**Facilitate Inventory Management processes:**

  

* Act as lead for achieving inventory targets, including management of aged, non-prime and surplus inventories for given product family
* Set and review EIO/APO/IBP targets for all SKUs within scope
  + Review and adjust system generated targets
  + Adjust/refine calculation parameters to increase accuracy over time
* Coordinate annual inventory target review with Business Team during corporate plan
* Coordinate annual SKU rationalization exercise with Product Management, Sales and Site SC
  

**Contribute to Supply Chain Improvement Initiatives**

  

* Identify/lead/coordinate APO/IBP improvement efforts
* Contribute to Supply Chain optimization initiatives
* Participate in Demand and or Supply Planning related networks
* Participate in Business Segment Team meetings and initiatives as needed
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve SPE
* Identify S&OP related master data needs and participate in master data maintenance

**About You**
-------------

**Skills and Qualifications**

  

* Familiarity with SAP IBP and APO - if no experience, ability to learn quickly
* Good analytical skills with a fluent knowledge of Excel and Power point
* Ability to drive functional excellence through a willingness to aggressively pursue new and creative approaches to resolve problems
* Demonstrated sound business judgment, decision making skills, customer focus and strong GI mindset
* Demonstrated strong leadership skills (either formal or informal) and ability to create ownership and commitment to the organization's purpose
* Demonstrated ability to influence and promote change to achieve desired results
* Ability to handle a high volume of work in a fast paced environment
  

**Key Interfaces**

  

* Regional Sales and Demand Planners
* Marketing - Product Managers, Planners
* Manufacturing - Technical leader, Quality, Operations SLS/Managers
* Site Supply Chain – Production Scheduler, Logistics Planning, Raw material planner
* Basic Chemicals – Feed Materials Planner
* Customer Service - CAS in case escalation needed on ATP issues
* Replenisher Team
  

**Development Opportunities**

  

* Exposure to senior business management, regional sales teams processes and tools
* Supply Chain activity involvement with business units
* Insight into P&R products, markets and key business processes
* Insight into global PE supply chain
* Occasional travel to Manufacturing Site meetings and Asset Business Team Meetings

**Your benefits**
-----------------

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking & cross-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations & holidays

To lead the people, compliance, workforce-discipline and HR-system agenda for Silco’s Bhiwadi plant and support company-wide HR governance. The role will build dependable manpower systems for approximately 180 employees, strengthen industrial relations and contractor control, and ensure accurate, lawful and timely HR operations.

Key Responsibilities

· Prepare annual and monthly manpower plans for staff, workmen, trainees and contract labour in coordination with the COO, Plant Head and department heads.

· Own end-to-end recruitment: job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, reference checks, salary fitment, offer release, joining and induction.

· Maintain complete employee and contractor documentation, including KYC, appointment records, UAN/ESIC data, police verification/undertakings, skills classification and 7-day worker suitability records.

· Build HR policies, SOPs, employee handbook, onboarding, separation, grievance and disciplinary frameworks appropriate for a manufacturing plant.

· Drive employee engagement, communication meetings, suggestion schemes, welfare initiatives, safety coordination and supervisor capability-building.

· Maintain HR dashboards using HRMS/ERP, SAP Business One inputs, Excel and Google Sheets; present weekly and monthly reports to management.

· Control contractor billing approval from an HR-compliance perspective and ensure no commercial payment is released without verified attendance and documentation.

Protect confidentiality of salary, employee records, investigations and management information

* New client acquisition and successful closure of BPO contracts.
* Revenue generation and achievement of business development targets.
* Value and volume of new business opportunities converted.

* Acquisition of strategic and large enterprise accounts.

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business development leader with a strong domestic BPO network, a demonstrated ability to win large accounts, and the capability to translate market opportunities into sustainable business growth.

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  
Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  
Practice / Domain: Digital Experience, API Integration & Retail/Lubricants Ecosystem  
  
Role Summary & Context  
  
We are seeking a visionary Solution Architect to lead the architectural design and global rollout of a next generation Unified Experience and Orchestration Platform for Lubricants Ecosystem program global indirect channel initiative partnering with independent auto workshops, distributors, and internal teams. Currently, regional markets operate across fragmented backend systems (SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, and legacy dealer platforms), resulting in inconsistent workflows and disjointed user journeys.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
  
1. Architectural Vision & MACH Design  
  
. Headless Experience Architecture: Design a decoupled, composable frontend architecture (React / Next.js SPA) utilizing a unified Design System (WCAG 2.0 compliant) that eliminates i frames and system switching for Distributors, Workshops, and Internal client users.  
. Backend for Frontend (BFF) & API Strategy: Architect a robust BFF and API Gateway layer (Azure API Management / Kong) that abstracts regional backend schema variations ("API drift") into a globally standardized contract for the UI.  
. Hybrid Process Orchestration: Design the orchestration strategy balancing synchronous, low latency API orchestration with asynchronous event driven choreography using Camunda / Temporal and Apache Kafka / Azure Event Grid.  
  
2. Enterprise Integration & Guardrail Governance  
  
. Stateless & Transient Enforcement: Strictly enforce architectural guardrails ensuring no new System of Record (SoR) is created, and no business logic is duplicated in the experience layer. Design short term caching strategies (e.g., Redis) for slow legacy ERP reads while ensuring real time write backs to authoritative sources.  
. Heterogeneous System Connectivity: Define integration patterns across MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, or SAP Integration Suite to seamlessly connect SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, Client Lubricants DB, and regional third party distributor systems.  
. End to End Observability & Security: Implement enterprise security using Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, OAuth 2.0, RBAC) and establish end to end auditability via standardized correlation IDs across distributed transactions.  
  
Required Experience & Skills  
  
Architecture Patterns: Proven expertise in MACH Architecture (Microservices, API first, Cloud native, Headless), BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns, Event Driven Architecture (EDA), and Domain Driven Design (DDD).  
Frontend & UI Layer: Strong architectural understanding of React, Next.js, or Vue.js, Micro frontends, Single Page Applications (SPAs), enterprise Design Systems, and WCAG 2.0 accessibility standards.  
Orchestration & BPM: Hands on experience architecting stateful/stateless workflows using Camunda (8/Zeebe), Temporal, or equivalent lightweight microservices orchestration engines.  
Integration & Messaging: Deep expertise in API Gateways (Azure APIM, Kong), iPaaS/ESB platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, SAP Integration Suite), and event brokers (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Grid).  
Backend & Caching: Proficiency in Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/GraphQL APIs, and transient in memory caching (Redis) to mitigate legacy ERP latency.  
Cloud, DevOps & IAM: Production experience with Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) or OpenShift on Azure or AWS, CI/CD pipelines, APM observability tools, and Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth2/OIDC/SSO).  
  
Overall Experience: 10+ years in Enterprise IT, with 5+ years as a Solution Architect designing large scale, multi market digital platforms and integration layers.
